SPACE TO SEE EVERY DETAIL

An open space.
Furniture takes centre stage.

Warm Brown ash, chevron grain, and slender brass lines. Four collection zones come together in one open exhibition, with light flooring, display signs, and generous aisles to discover each piece from every angle.

A 3D reconstruction based on the SIENNA 2026 catalogue. Exhibition styling and complementary elements are design interpretations.

THE SIGNATURE / CHEVRON VENEER

MATERIAL MATTERS

Warm by nature.
Precise by design.

More than a shade of brown. Wood grain meets in a chevron pattern, framed by fine metal lines. Photographed ash textures combine with bevels, roughness, and normal maps to capture the changing light.

01 / TIMBER
Veneer / Vic Ash Timber

02 / METAL
Slender frames, softly brushed details
A brass tone drawn from the reference
03 / TEXTILE
White striped bedding
